name: Jidai Matsuri procession paid seats
statusNote: The 2026 sale date is from the Kyoto City Tourism Association's official site. The 2027 date is not announced yet; we show early September as a guide.
howToBuy: The Kyoto City Tourism Association sells paid seats for the Jidai Matsuri procession on October 22.
In 2026, seats went on sale at 10:00 Japan time on September 8. Buy online through the link on the official page, or at Seven-Eleven stores in Japan.
Seats are in the Kyoto Gyoen National Garden and along Oike-dori Street. Prices run from ¥5,000 to ¥15,500.
rulesToKnow: On October 17, 2026, only general seats on Oike-dori Street were still on sale for the 2026 procession.
The 2027 sale date has not been announced. We will update this page when it is.

soldOut.label: Watch from the street for free along the route
